config.name: Capacity and Risk Overview — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Capacity and Risk Overview
Executive capacity, license, and coverage-risk signals. Host utilization deep-dives via OOTB Capacity.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • Is license pressure rising?
  • Are unmonitored or minimal resources creating risk?
  • Where should capacity investigation continue?
Recommended review flow
  1. License strip — Cloud and local
  2. Coverage gaps — Unmonitored / minimal
  3. OOTB capacity — Infra utilization
Where to go next
  • Ops Coverage detail → 24
  • Technology Directory → 34
  • Platform Value → 11
Tip: Empty or zero values may mean healthy state or missing tokens/LogicModules — confirm before concluding.
